unit: Geometry · Chapter I. Volumes of solids
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 12 mathematics textbooks (general stream)

stages.headline: Volume measures the space a solid takes up; the unit is the volume of a cube with edge 1: 1 cm³, 1 dm³, 1 m³.
stages.headlineEnglish: Volume measures the space a solid takes up; the unit is the volume of a cube with edge 1: 1 cm³, 1 dm³, 1 m³.

stages.headline: Volume tells how many unit cubes fit in a solid: a 3 × 2 × 2 box holds 12 unit cubes.
stages.headlineEnglish: Volume tells how many unit cubes fit in a solid: a 3 × 2 × 2 box holds 12 unit cubes.

stages.headline: 1 m³ = 1000 dm³ = 1 000 000 cm³, and 1 litre = 1 dm³.
stages.headlineEnglish: 1 m³ = 1000 dm³ = 1 000 000 cm³, and 1 litre = 1 dm³.
